_comment: Synthetic schema example for /api/anchor-receipt.schema.v1.json. This file is NOT a snapshot of any production inscription — it is a fixed demonstration of the schema's shape. All hex strings, tx_ids, block numbers, and timestamps shown here are synthetic placeholders that document field formats only; they do not refer to any real on-chain transaction or moment in time. The operator XPR account 'metalfreedom' and the sink account 'fyhistory' are the confirmed production names on Metal A-chain mainnet (= the runtime receipt will carry exactly these values); only the time-varying fields (tx_id, block_num, block_time, dag_root_hash, hashes) are synthetic. Production runtime receipt is published at /api/anchor-receipt.json by scripts/gen-anchor-receipt.sh on the validator host AFTER the seven-PASS verification chain completes (see verification_status field). 2026-06-23 update: this example carries the additive audit fields (chain_backend / signing_actor / signing_permission / verification_status). See docs/MERKLE_DAG_SPEC.md.
